Name: Tamar, Daughter of Absalom
Summary: Tamar, daughter of Absalom, is named as his only daughter, a beautiful woman, at the end of the account of Absalom's return to Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Absalom's daughter Tamar, named for his wronged sister, closes the account of his return.
LifeLesson: A daughter named for a wronged aunt carries a family's grief forward.
